name: Most Likely To
description: Vote for the friend who fits each prompt best, and score by reading the room.
summary: Each round shows a prompt such as 'Who is most likely to forget their own birthday?' Everyone secretly votes for another player on their phone. The TV reveals the totals and crowns the most-voted player. Players who voted with the crowd score a point, so the best room reader wins. Votes stay secret, and only the totals are ever shown.
